verdict.rationale: Ollama's download page provides a one-line install script, so users install it without building from source. Community reports add shipped ROCm containers and a desktop app for macOS and Windows. First-party evidence never states that the script delivers a prebuilt binary or names specific package formats, so coverage is partial rather than complete. missing for 10: first-party documentation of prebuilt binaries or packages per platform (macOS, Windows, Linux, Docker), package-manager distribution (e.g. Homebrew, apt), and official confirmation of container images.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install using prebuilt binaries or packages instead of compiling from source
